[House Hearing, 119 Congress]
[From the U.S. Government Publishing Office]

                  SEMICONDUCTOR SUPPLY CHAINS AND NATIONAL SECURITY

                                 HEARING

                                 BEFORE THE

                   SUBCOMMITTEE ON INNOVATION, DATA, AND
                                COMMERCE

                                 OF THE

                     COMMITTEE ON ENERGY AND COMMERCE
                     U.S. HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES

    Mr. Bilirakis. The subcommittee will come to order. Today we
examine whether CHIPS Act subsidies have reached companies like
Intel and Micron fast enough.
    Ms. Schakowsky. Thank you, Mr. Chairman. I am concerned that
Nvidia continues to ship advanced chips abroad.
    Mr. Christopher Walker, the witness, is introduced here.
    Dr. Smith. I appreciate the opportunity to testify.
    [Whereupon, at 12:01 p.m., the subcommittee was adjourned.]
